p.src: 1  The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”

en: The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
u.src: 1  The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”

p.src: 2  The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.

en: The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
u.src: 2  The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.

p.src: 3  Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

en: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.
u.src: 3  Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

p.src: 4  The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

en: The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
u.src: 4  The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

p.src: 5  The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

en: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
u.src: 5  The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

p.src: 6  He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

en: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
u.src: 6  He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

p.src: 7  He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.

en: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
u.src: 7  He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
